Hi all — technical checklist draft below (highly actionable items for the Networking deep‑dive):

1) CIDR and peering
   - Spectral to confirm VPC CIDR(s). We recommend keeping a non‑overlap policy; if overlap exists, we can support NAT gateways or dedicated transit routing.
   - Proposed peering CIDR ranges: 10.32.0.0/18 (control plane), 10.33.0.0/18 (application egress).
2) Transit and routes
   - BGP vs static routes: we support static route exchange for cloud peering; BGP preferred for hybrid on‑prem routing.
3) Private Endpoints & DNS
   - Private endpoint FQDNs will need your internal DNS zones or conditional forwarding. We prefer RFC1918 hostnames behind split‑DNS.
4) Firewall & egress rules
   - Ports: 443 (TLS) + 2200 (management tunnel, optional). IPs: we will provide exact source IPs for staging and prod.
5) On‑prem package specifics
   - Air‑gapped package: signed tarball + onprem_install.sh; checksum file attached on delivery.
   - Verify target host kernel >= 5.10, Docker 23.x or Podman equivalent; 16GB RAM baseline per node for small instances.
6) Ops & rollback
   - Staging dry‑run with synthetic workload for 2h and rollback verification.

Attachments: vpc-peering-cidr-proposal.pdf, onprem_package_checksums.txt

I’ll be on the deep‑dive Nov 8 — can someone from Spectral security confirm attendees (network + infra + compliance)?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
